text:
Jamie: FYI  Midwest Hack Night confirmed Sept 14. We have a table + 6-minute mini demo slot. Need owners for speaker submission, demo script, swag pack, shipping, and lead capture. Shipping cutoff Sep 4. Who can take speaker submission by EOD?

Claire: I can submit on our behalf. Will compress the latency/cost story into 5 slides + a 90s live demo. Any prohibition on live code?

Ben: Live code ok but keep network calls minimal. I'll prepare a recorded fallback clip. For demo we need a small 13" monitor, HDMI, 2 lavs, power strip. I'll be onsite contact.

Priya: Proposed swag: 200 stickers, 100 postcards, 60 enamel pins. Vendor: lakeside-swag.io. PO #PO-7019. ETA Sep 9. Pins pushed budget ~+$250; suggest postcards -> 70 to balance.

Zoe: Let's cut postcards to 70 and keep pins 60. Also want 100 QR cards that point to a short form with an incentive (swag raffle).

Jamie: Decision: stickers 200, postcards 70, pins 60, QR cards 100. Priya please finalize PO and confirm shipping address. Lead plan: QR -> short Typeform -> webhook -> HubSpot list "Midwest Hack Night" -> assign to Zoe for 48h -> SDR queue. Claire, can you own the talk submission and short bio?

Claire: Owning submission + bio. Will upload headshot and 1-line bio to the drive by Sep 2. Also will draft demo script.

Ben: I'll add utm params to the demo link: ?utm_source=midwest_hack_night&utm_campaign=sept14_demo. Also will upload the recorded fallback clip to drive.

event-bot: Venue note uploaded: Riverview Labs, table location confirmed (Row B3). Arrival window Sep 14 6:45-8:00pm.

Priya: Shipping contact: MidCity Couriers. Tracking MC112233. I'll add "Hold for Redwood Inference - Jamie" and confirm pickup window. PO uploaded to event sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1midwest-plan

Zoe: I'll build the Typeform and Zapier mapping. Form fields: name, email, company, interest (benchmarks/integration/demo), opt-in for raffle. Zap will POST to HubSpot with utm fields and owner set to Zoe.

Jamie: Quick Zap snippet for reference:
```
trigger: typeform.webhook
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact
payload: {"properties":[{"property":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"property":"utm_source","value":"midwest_hack_night"},{"property":"owner","value":"Zoe"}]}
```
Please test with a sandbox entry.

Claire: Dry run Sep 12 @ 9am PT. Who can make that? Ben and Zoe please.

Ben: I'll be there. Will bring monitor + fallback clip on USB.

Zoe: I'll test the form and zap before Sep 6 and post results. Also recommend we include a 1-page leave-behind micro-benchmark showing cost vs latency and 3 quick integration tips. I can draft by Sep 3.

Priya: Shipping ETA Sep 9 looks good. I'll DM MidCity to confirm hold and upload tracking to the sheet. Onsite layout: monitor center, postcards left, stickers top-right, pins under table in small bowl.

Jamie: Recap owners: Claire = talk + bio + 1pg leave-behind draft, Ben = AV + demo link + fallback clip, Priya = swag order + shipping, Zoe = Typeform + Zap + lead routing. I'll send invites and a short runbook template. :rocket:
